name: OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.tree_gap
type_text:
∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} (T : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Tree),
  T.WellFormed →
    ∀ (m : ℕ → ℕ),
      T.IsMainBranch m →
        ∀ (R : ℝ),
          (∀ (k : ℕ), T.repr (T.auxNode m k) ≤ T.repr (m k)) →
            (∀ (k : ℕ), ↑(T.dist (m k) (T.auxNode m k)) ≤ R) →
              ∀ (gamma : ℝ) (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d)
                (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (k : ℕ),
                ∃ p ≤ k,
                  ↑k - ↑p ≤ R ∧
                    ∃ I ⊆ Finset.Ico p k,
                      ∀ (η : ℕ → Ω),
                        T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m k) =
                          T.vertex gamma x0 g η (m k) +
                            gamma • ∑ i ∈ I, g (T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m i)) (η (T.auxSample m i))
